steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Maria! How is it looking?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hold on just a little longer! Let me get this last screw!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Tighten it up! Really get it in there!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Got it! Wait, hold on! I think I know what's wrong with the battery slot connection down here—!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hurry up! You know how heavy the jukebox is! I can't hold it much longer!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Your cheese, V.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...This isn't going to blow up on us like last time now, is it?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: A jukebox blowing up? That would be quite a sight to behold.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: How can you be sure it won't happen? If it's got something to do with Originium, Kowal will find a way to mess it up.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Who's talking behind my back?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Master Kowal! C-Careful! Stop shaking it!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Ughh, my bad. Sorry, Maria.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: V! Once I'm done over here, I'm going to teach you a lesson!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Good, I'll be waiting!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I can always count on you two to liven things up here. Just remember, if you end up fighting, anything you break, you'll have to pay for.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You've heard him babble on and on like that for years, but when did you ever see him win?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: He handed you your behind just the other day.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Ugh... I was drunk last time. Plus, I had arthritis... That didn't count!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: *Chugging intensifies*—Hah! When we made that trip to the borderlands back in the day, he wouldn't dare talk to me like this...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: V! What kind of lies are you on about this time?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You followed me to that hellhole! Who were you, if not just a affinity?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That was years ago! All of your affinities made it big enough to be your king by now!
Maria!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Uagh—! Son of a bitch! What'd you let go for?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: M-My bad... Let me hide here for a minute...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia, go easy on the door. I've had to replace it more than a few times just this month.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: *Sigh*... This is exactly why I haven't forked out the money for an automatic door.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What's going on? Why are you so worked up?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're there, aren't you?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ma-ri-a!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eeek—!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey, Maria, she's coming this way. Doesn't look like that jukebox's keeping you out of sight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh... Why is this jukebox so small...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: How's she looking?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Bad. I haven't seen her this mad since that time she threw that drunken knight prick out.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: —Oh, now she's smiling.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That's even worse!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Kowal?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Ahem—V! Time to hit the bottle! You were talking about me behind my back, weren't you?! I'll show you I meant it when I said I could drink you under the table!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Tsk, you coward. You're just running away!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Then perhaps you should try and see if you can help Maria's case?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I-I don't even know what's going on with the two of them! I'm staying out of it!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ma-ri-a, what are you hiding here for?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're trying to keep something from me, aren't you? Not that I don't already know what's going on.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ha, haha...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You know what it means to enter the Major, right?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Ohh... No wonder Zofia's furious.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Why didn't you come talk to me first?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Cause I knew you'd be mad, Zofia...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You bet I am! You don't have the faintest idea what you're going up against!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I know a little about it...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Through your sister? The Radiant Knight of Kazimierz, one of the youngest miracles to grace the Major? Yes, of course you'd know a lot about that.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But—you—aren't—Margaret!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: D-Don't pinch my ear—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But, but! The family's in really hot water right now!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm not kidding! I may not even have a bed to sleep in come next year! We'll be out of furniture to sell!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: The Association doesn't recognize a noble family without a Knight Primus. I've lost track of how many times they've come to complain about that... I-I don't have any other choice...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...If it comes to that, you can come live at my place. We've got a big bath and two gardens...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: In any case, you shouldn't have signed up for the Major... That's way too rash of you...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Even before my grandfather passed, my uncle never wanted anything to do with the Association, let alone after.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: And it's been a while since my sister was kicked out of Kazimierz. If I don't even try to step up here...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Even so, you should've at least talked to us... Don't just blindly chase whatever idea pops into your head.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm really sorry... but I knew you'd stop me if I told you...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Of course I would!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...What about now?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...'The Radiant Knight appears once more? Will the debuting knight of the Nearl family restore honor to the nobles?'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The headline on today's sports page.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha... Margaret's as popular as ever...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: This is no joke!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The media may be hyping things up with their weird headlines and lies, but It's not too late to quit, I'm telling you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But if I don't do this, the Nearl family will go bankrupt and lose our status as nobles!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I know what I'm doing, Zofia... I... I have to do this.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Geez... Marcin, you know what knight sports are like. Help me out here—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Yeah, I say let her try.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —What!?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Marcin! Thanks!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No, no, no. With the way she is, she wouldn't win in a fight against me even if I tied one hand behind my back! Are you sure?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What a mean thing to say!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Now, now. You made it to the Final 16 in the Major. She'd be earning more than a passing grade to take you with just one hand.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That's right. V here wouldn't even stand a chance even if you tied one hand behind your back.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You wanna say that again!?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: All of us regulars here may all be old, retired folks past our prime, but we still got an eye for people, and we know what potential looks like... creepy old men that we are... Eh, she'll do fine.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's no way to talk! That's not even a compliment!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You know what I'm talking about! Don't tell me you knights don't get sick of talking like a walking encyclopedia!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Ahem—V is right.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I trust Maria's talent. Her Arts and swordsmanship isn't bad at all. You of all people should know. You've been practicing with her since she was just a kid.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But she's been so into mechanical work these last few years. I thought she wanted to become a mechanic...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That's just a hobby. I don't want to give it up... but you've got to do what you've got to do, right?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...I still haven't forgiven you for making that decision on your own. This really isn't a joke.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...I agree with Zofia on that.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I admire you doing everything you can for your family, and with a smile on your face, but knight sports aren't all fun and games like they are for tourists and the crowd.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: In fact, you'll find there's nothing fun about it.
Marcin lifts his hand up—Much of his arm has been replaced with robotic parts. The joint rattles metallically.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: This is what happens if you let your guard down.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yeah... I remember that. You were up against a Victorian with two blades.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You still won, in the end.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Yes, but at what price?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: This is the kind of glory you get in the Major. Now even cleaning a wine glass is a chore.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The Major, hmph.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: There's no mercy or respect in the arena. The only thing real there is the blood that splatters the ground.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The audience cheers for their entertainment, and the sponsors treat you well because it fills their coffers.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Think it through, look at all the difficulties you'll face, and only then should you press on. That's what makes a real knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I understand...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Yeah. I'm serious.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle's always said that even if we're stripped of our nobility and the family crest falls, it won't be the end of our lineage...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But I still want to protect everything that my sister and grandfather fought to defend.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret isn't here anymore, and as one of the youngest members of the Nearl family, I can't just stand by and watch my family fall from grace.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If I do that, I'll end up hating myself to death.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Even when you know the path ahead will be ruthless and treacherous, you still embark on the journey. That's what it means to be a knight.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You can do it. This one's for you.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hear, hear. To Maria!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (Holds mug up)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...*Sigh*, I was hoping you people would help me talk her out of it. Turns out, you're encouraging her.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... Zofia. Please, Auntie Zofia! Please, I beg you!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Stop it! Leave my age out of this! I'm only five years older than you!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Well, I'm part of the Nearl family. I know how you feel, but I still think—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'll work on my swordsmanship skills! I'll be good! Please, you can trust me!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh yeah! Why don't you be my coach—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Whoops—)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Now that reminds me. When was the last time we trained together?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Probably before Margaret left Kazimierz?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And what was the last technique I taught you? Where did it come from? How do you apply it in combat?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uh... Hahaha... I-I wonder?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yes, this is perfect.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We'll meet at the training grounds in the garden tomorrow morning. You won't be late, will you? Lady Maria, the Knightess?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hm? Y-Yeah... I'll be there.
